none: PAS NLM-F1A017: Roman Coin: Nummus of Valentinian I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of Valentinian I (364-375), Emperor right issue of Arles mint, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped, diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN VALENTI[---]AVG. Reverse description: Emperor advancing left dragging captive and holding labarum ORF II in field. Reverse inscription: GLORIARO [MANORVM]. Diameter: 17mm, Weight: 2.12gms, die…
